title: Idempotent Side-Effecting Tool Calls
signature: class IdempotentExecutor: __init__(self, clock, ttl), execute(self, key, tool, args, fn) -> dict
hints: Store, per key, a fingerprint of the request (tool plus canonical JSON of args), the result, and the time it ran.
Canonical JSON means json.dumps(args, sort_keys=True). Two dicts with the same content in a different key order are the same request.
Expire lazily: on lookup, if now - stored_at >= ttl, delete the entry and treat the call as new. Don't store failures, so a retry can run the tool again.
